title: deliver_article fans out to all followers sequentially — O(n) latency before response
description: deliver_article iterates followers with a sequential for loop; each iteration awaits deliver_one (a full HTTP round-trip). With F followers and average RTT T, the caller waits F*T before deliver_article returns. The caller is a tokio::spawn, so it does not block NNTP/JMAP responses, but it does saturate a task if followers are slow. Fix: use futures::future::join_all or tokio::task::JoinSet to fan out deliveries concurrently. Expected impact: with 100 followers at 200ms RTT each, current latency is 20s; concurrent delivery is bounded by the slowest single peer (200ms).
